subject.title: fix(gateway): reap stale MCP processes on session reset regardless of…

question: Which MCP retirement contract should this PR use before merge: drained-only, force-clear-then-retire, or deferred retirement after active MCP leases release?
rationale: The patch touches gateway session teardown and MCP process ownership; source evidence shows direct disposal can race active leases, so automation should not choose the permanent lifecycle semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Repair the lifecycle contract first
options.body: Require this PR or a replacement to retire MCP runtimes only after drain, force-clear, or lease-aware deferred disposal, with reset/delete timeout tests before merge.

options.title: Require stronger live proof first
options.body: Ask for redacted live gateway logs or terminal output from an active-MCP reset/delete timeout before deciding whether this ordering is acceptable.

options.title: Pause for broader MCP runtime work
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want the stale-process cluster solved through the broader atomic lease/deferred-retirement runtime design.

recommendation.title: Repair the lifecycle contract first
recommendation.body: Require this PR or a replacement to retire MCP runtimes only after drain, force-clear, or lease-aware deferred disposal, with reset/delete timeout tests before merge.
